title: Hush Hour
inspired_by: https://youtu.be/vH0pd4SomN8 (premise only: fooling a crowd of infected with a clever trick)
summary: A bus driver hides forty strangers in the dark and keeps them silent with one rule: no sound.

beats.text: I drive the number nine bus. That night I had forty passengers.
A crowd stepped out of the rain and stood in front of the bus.
I killed the engine and lights. I whispered one rule: no sound.
A baby began to cry in the back. Its mother hushed it under her coat.
The crowd turned its heads, all at once, toward our dark windows.
I did the only thing I could think of. I pressed the horn of the bus.
The horn echoed down the road. They turned and followed it, away from us.
Nobody said a word until the sun came up.
I opened the doors. Forty seats, forty people, all breathing.
Then I checked the ticket machine. It had printed forty-one.
